question: Which reading of a grown split base's disagreement-count table, between every start's sorted row and the full table, recovers the number of orders k and the lattice dimension, and does a local one?

definitions.N1: row with the nearest starts' rows
definitions.W2: two rounds of 1-WL on the count table
definitions.B_r: view of the table within count r of each start, start marked, up to renaming

public_inputs.engines: STATE-RULES-20261117-001B rules.py and COUNT-BALLS-20261118-001B census.py, unchanged
public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py; then merge.py <out dir>

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: P1-P8 of research/ROW-ARRANGE-20261118-001/preregistration.md, scored from merge.py's results.json.
cheapest_meaningful_control: checks.py: reading a reproduces COUNT-BALLS at n = 7; invariance under renaming; canonical views against brute force; the two proved families.

predictions.P1: N1 determines k, lam at n = 7
predictions.P3: WL complete at 7 and cheapest to 12; determines k, lam at 8
predictions.P5: least r with B_r determining k: 6 at n = 7, 8 at n = 8
predictions.P7: families at 8 find one of a's k-mixing groups
predictions.P8: families at 9: WL determines k, lam; a mixes k

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as read from results.json

stop_rule: One run; read-out; proofs; referee hand-off; report.
runtime: 8 workers, 3 GB per case, through scripts/longrun.py (ROW-ARRANGE-B1).
